content:
Today (the 17th), some netizens uploaded a clip on social media showing what appears to be a closed-circuit television footage taken in a back alley. The footage shows three people chatting on site, with at least two clearly wearing uniforms of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. Based on the Department's uniform information, the two are suspected to be a Hawker Control Officer and a Senior Hawker Control Officer.

The footage shows the two officer-level personnel chatting in the back alley. One of them first took out a cigarette and smoked, then another Senior Hawker Control Officer walked over, took out a cigarette pack and a lighter, brushed aside his/her hair lightly, put a cigarette into his/her mouth, and walked away with his/her back to the camera, with a wisp of smoke emanating from his/her side.

"集誌社" (Collective News Agency) made enquiries to the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department as to whether the persons in the footage are employees of the Department. The Department confirmed in its reply to the enquiry that the persons in the footage are personnel of the Hawker Control Team of a district of the Department. The spokesperson stated that the incident took place in early June this year. The reporter enquired whether staff of the Department are allowed to smoke while in uniform, and if the footage is true, whether the personnel have violated regulations, and whether this would affect the image of the Department. The Department replied that, according to established departmental regulations, staff are prohibited from smoking while in uniform and in public places.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department stated that the Department attaches great importance to the discipline and professional conduct of its staff, and has initiated a disciplinary investigation into the incident. Appropriate action will be taken in accordance with established procedures and the results of the investigation. The spokesperson also pointed out that the Department has clear requirements on the conduct of personnel while in uniform, and any behaviour that violates departmental disciplinary requirements will be followed up seriously.
